about: What a reader or an admin can switch between (REQ-053, proposed). A concept is a named preset of the four settings; choosing one sets them all, and any setting can then be changed on its own. Themes change only the neutral surface and text tokens in public/css/app.css; the accent stays ink (a colour accent needs both partners). Add an option here and its CSS in app.css; test/appearance-unit.js checks that every option has its CSS and every concept names real options.
